title: A Pharmacokinetic Interaction Study Between Apatinib and Rosuvastatin or Metformin in Solid Tumor Subjects.

sections.abstract: The primary objective of the study was to assess investigate the pharmacokinetic effects of Apatinib on Rosuvastatin or Metformin. The secondary objective of the study was to assess the safety of Apatinib alone or Rosuvastatin/Metformin alone or concomitant medication.
